functions.title: Azure Functions Skills
functions.prompt: Read https://aka.ms/azure-functions-starter and follow it to set up Azure Functions Skills in this directory. Use the one-liner for your OS and coding agent; I authorize that one command for this directory only. Do not open a Canvas. Load no other skills until setup is reported; then use the skills it added to this directory.
